corrections.subject: 0046db5a / 0046db66
corrections.was: docs/SCENE_ENTITY_CREATE.md open question: which of the two bags is authored
corrections.is: the clone at 0046db5a is the authored bag (the scene record's own properties); the argument bag merged at 0046db66 only fills gaps

corrections.subject: group-list precedence
corrections.was: a first reading of this packet attributed the entity group list to 008f5ab3 and concluded that a later group overwrites an earlier one
corrections.is: the entity group list is 0046cf40's loop with keepExisting = 1, so the first group wins; 008f5ab3's flag-0 branch belongs to the registry-driven caller
corrections.evidence: 0046d2f4 PUSH 0x1 survives 008d9980 (no stack argument; its zero-push site is 008f5a9f) and 00469b60 (cleans its own), so it is the flag at 0046d30c. 0046d34e passes 0 as 008f5a00's third argument, the registry 008f5aa9 would dereference.

merge_rule.stage_1_parse: for a scene entity the group list is read by BSP_SceneFile_ReadEntityBlock 0046cf40, not by the bag parser: 0046d2c3 builds the empty bag and the loop 0046d2f4-0046d326 merges each named group with keepExisting = 1 (0046d30c), so the FIRST group named wins a shared key; 0046d34e then parses the body into the same bag and an authored line overwrites whatever the groups left. 008f5a00 has its own group-merge branch at 008f5ab3 with keepExisting = 0 (last group wins), gated on the group registry in argument 3, which 0046d34e passes as 0.
merge_rule.stage_2_create: 0046d930 clones the entity record's authored bag (0046db5a) and merges the caller's bag with keepExisting = 1 (0046db66), so the argument can only add keys the authored record never mentioned.
merge_rule.absent_key: clone with 008f4f60, copy the source ordinal at 008f562e, insert with 008f33f0
merge_rule.sub_bag: recursion at 008f55f6 on both sides' +0Ch with the same flag; sub-bags merge key by key and are never replaced wholesale
merge_rule.ordinal: only the clone branch moves an ordinal, so an overwritten key keeps the destination's insertion order
merge_rule.assign_existing: 008f23e0 has no clone branch and no flag: source always wins for a key present in the destination, and a key absent from the destination is dropped
